video_title: Film Don't Lie: Darryn Peterson Watches Himself on Film... and Explains Everything

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on his independent mindset and father's influence
quotes.excerpt: I don't really lean on anyone growing up. My dad told me, you're the oldest in the house.
quotes.quote: I think I used the wrong words when I said that. I should have said I'm more to myself when things get hard. I don't really lean on anyone growing up. My dad told me, you're the oldest in the house, you're going to have to be a man one day, so handle it however you got to handle it.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on what fans should expect from his game

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on ignoring crowd heckling during games
quotes.excerpt: I couldn't understand what they were saying. I was smiling at somebody on the sideline.
quotes.quote: I'm not going to lie, I couldn't understand what they were saying. I was smiling at somebody on the sideline. Somebody on the sideline said something like you're soft, but I didn't even hear it until after the game.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on his aggressive shot selection and confidence
quotes.excerpt: Coach told me to make a play. I tried to pump fake to see if he would jump.
quotes.quote: The timeout before, coach told me to make a play. It happened to be an out-of-bounds play and they came to me. I tried to pump fake to see if he would jump. He didn't jump, so once his hand dropped, I just got it up. There is no such thing as a bad shot. Coach told me, if you can get it up, shoot it.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on the intensity of playing at Allen Fieldhouse
quotes.excerpt: I was really bummed out because I only could play like a certain amount of minutes.
quotes.quote: I was really bummed out because I only could play like a certain amount of minutes. It was fun to play against each other in high school and then to play against each other on this platform. We are cool with each other, so it was a great match up. People hyped it up, but I guess to me and him, I bet it was just a game.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on maintaining composure during high-stakes games
quotes.excerpt: I try to keep a level head all the games.
quotes.quote: I try to keep a level head all the games. I feel like when you try to get hyped up and stuff, it doesn't go as planned, so I try to keep the same mentality every game.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on the importance of hitting early shots
quotes.excerpt: Hard ones early makes it kind of tough because if you miss that first one.
quotes.quote: Coach Phil has been getting on me about my first shot of the games. Hard ones early makes it kind of tough because if you miss that first one, it kind of determines the rest of the game, so let's try to get close. That's what I try to say, get close ones on my first shots.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on his Michael Jordan-inspired finishing move
quotes.excerpt: My uncle actually texted me and said like the Michael Jordan finish.
quotes.quote: My uncle actually texted me and said like the Michael Jordan finish. So yeah, for sure.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on his court vision and decision making
quotes.excerpt: If you screen, they probably going to guard me with two, so just watch out.
quotes.quote: Got the steal. Flory tried to screen, I'm like, if you screen, they probably going to guard me with two, so just watch out. Let me get this one-on-one.

quotes.speaker: Darryn Peterson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson on the missed foul call and his reaction
quotes.excerpt: I think it should have been a foul. I would have celebrated.
quotes.quote: I think it should have been a foul. I would have celebrated. Everybody was saying like, this is when they were saying I don't care about basketball and stuff because of certain stuff, but I didn't get the foul call so I had to get back. Coach probably would have tweaked if I would have stayed down there yelling and they scored.
